findings: Production credentials in appsettings.json — A live Dodo Payments API key, live BaseUrl, and Mode: "live" are present in appsettings.json which is tracked by git. If pushed, the live API key enters version-control history. Move to a secrets manager, environment variable, or an .gitignore-d appsettings.Production.json.

ArgumentOutOfRangeException surfaces as 500 on unexpected call paths — CreateDodoSessionCommandHandler throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for AmountInMinorUnits <= 0. Normal HTTP traffic is blocked by the controller guard before reaching the command, but any direct dispatcher (integration test, background job, another controller) will get an unhandled exception rather than a structured error. Replace the throw with a structured result to match the other handlers.

onTargetAmountInput clamps non-positive input silently — Typing 0 or a negative value leaves the targetAmount signal unchanged because the handler only sets the signal when parsed > 0. The isAmountInvalid alert box is therefore unreachable through keyboard input; the only feedback is a disabled submit button. Set the signal unconditionally and let isAmountInvalid provide the visual feedback.
